summary: Phase 5 frontend-only E2E testing of SkillTrace AI on the public URL. Covered: login (demo one-click + email/password + wrong-password toast), provider dashboard (KPIs, 36-row trainee table, confidence badges, at-risk panel with 17 high-risk rows, run follow-up cycle), enroll + duplicate-detection modal, messaging simulator (employed->wage->employer verification link, unemployed->reason, free-text ML classification), public employer verify page in a clean context (valid -> verified -> already-responded -> invalid token), admin analytics dashboard (4 KPIs, 6 Recharts, 5 filters, district ranking, provider drill-down), RBAC redirects both ways and logout. 2 HIGH bugs found: (1) provider can NEVER complete an enrollment (POST /enrollments -> 403, chicken-and-egg RBAC) leaving orphan trainee rows, (2) ProviderDashboard crashes with an uncaught TypeError (blank screen) when the JWT is invalid/expired. Everything else works. All QA_ test data cleaned (trainees back to 150).

critical.issue: 403 'Not authorized for this trainee' when a provider enrolls a BRAND-NEW trainee. accessible_trainee_ids() derives a provider's scope from trainees that already have an enrollment in the provider's programs, so a newly created trainee is never in scope -> chicken-and-egg. Provider enrollment (the core write flow of the app) is 100% broken, incl. the ?force=true duplicate path. Repro: /app/backend/tests/qa_enroll_repro.py (own program AND other program both 403). Fix: in assert_trainee_access for POST /enrollments, allow providers when the target program_id belongs to their provider_id (or stamp provider_id/created_by on the trainee at creation and use that for scoping).

minor.issue: No transaction/rollback: the trainee document is inserted, then the enrollment 403s, leaving an orphan trainee with no enrollment (3 orphans created during this run, cleaned up). Either create trainee+enrollment atomically in one endpoint or delete the trainee on enrollment failure.

A provider-initiated 'Run Follow-Up Cycle' processed 139 certified trainees across ALL providers (not scoped to the caller's provider_id) and reported '0 check-ins scheduled'. Scope the cycle to the caller's provider and/or surface 'nothing due' instead of a success toast with 0.

top_contributing_factors includes 'Gender: Male' / age as risk drivers. A government-facing explainable model that surfaces gender as a placement-risk factor is a fairness/ethics red flag; either drop protected attributes from the explanation or label them clearly as cohort context.

'haan job lag gayi 18k salary TCS me' -> sector_guess null (UI shows dash) and confidence 75% (keyword); 'nahi abhi tak koi kaam nahi mila' -> Unemployed but only 33% confidence via ml_fallback. Functional but the AI card looks weak in a demo.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: With an invalid/expired JWT the dashboard renders summary.placement_rate on a null summary -> 'Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading placement_rate)' and a blank/red error screen. The axios 401 interceptor clears localStorage but does NOT navigate, so the user only recovers by reloading a second time. Add an error state (retry + 'session expired' redirect to /login) and guard `if (!summary) return <ErrorState/>`.

Because POST /enrollments 403s, the modal shows the error toast 'Not authorized for this trainee' and stays open on the duplicate panel forever after clicking dup-force-create-btn; no way to know a trainee row was already created.

Old quick-reply chip groups stay rendered and clickable after being answered (after a free-text reply there were 14 reason chips from two groups), allowing duplicate outcome submissions. Disable/hide chips of answered messages.

Console DOM validation error on every open: a <span> wrapper is rendered inside <option> in the program <select> ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Render option text into a variable/string instead of an inline expression.

integration_issues.flow: Enroll New Trainee (new person and force-create duplicate)
integration_issues.issue: Never completes: POST /trainees 200 then POST /enrollments 403; toast 'Not authorized for this trainee'. Blocks the whole provider write path.
No /auth/me revalidation on boot; user object is trusted from localStorage. Expired token -> API 401s -> ProviderDashboard crash instead of redirect to /login.

issues: document.scrollWidth > clientWidth -> whole page scrolls horizontally on mobile; the trainee table should be the only horizontally scrollable region (wrap in min-w-0/overflow container)
The sonner toast (top-right) overlays the navbar and visually covers the Logout button for ~4s
When a filter narrows to one provider the single bar stretches the full chart width (set maxBarSize)
Provider X-axis labels are clipped at the left edge of chart-by-provider ('...gha Training Academy')
Date of birth uses the native browser date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere in the design system; no min/max DOB validation

action_items: CRITICAL: fix provider RBAC for POST /api/enrollments so a provider can enroll a brand-new trainee (scope by program.provider_id or stamp provider on the trainee), then re-test enroll + force-create duplicate end to end.
CRITICAL: make trainee+enrollment creation atomic (or roll back the trainee) so failures don't leave orphan trainee rows.
HIGH: add null/error states to ProviderDashboard and make the axios 401 interceptor redirect to /login (plus optional /auth/me boot revalidation).
MEDIUM: disable answered quick-reply chip groups in MessagingSimulator to prevent duplicate submissions.
MEDIUM: scope POST /api/followups/schedule to the calling provider; don't toast success for 0 scheduled.

LOW: remove gender from the risk explanation, fix the <span> inside <option> DOM error, fix mobile horizontal overflow, move toasts below the navbar, add maxBarSize to bar charts, replace native date input with shadcn Calendar.

Recommended: re-seed (cd /app/backend && python seed.py) — the simulator flows I exercised wrote 3 real employment records (Manoj Chavan, Sonali Joshi, one more) and 1 non-placement reason on seeded trainees, and 1 employment record is now employer_verified=true.
critical_code_review_comments: accessible_trainee_ids(): provider scope computed from existing enrollments makes creation of new trainee+enrollment impossible for the provider role — the RBAC model needs an ownership field on the trainee (provider_id/created_by) instead of deriving scope purely from enrollments.

ProviderDashboard.jsx renders summary.* without a null guard after a failed fetch (only `loading` is handled) — every API-failure path is an uncaught render crash. AdminDashboard/TraineeProfile correctly guard with `loading || !data`.
lib/api.js response interceptor clears the token on 401 but never navigates; AuthContext also trusts the localStorage user object without validating the JWT with /auth/me on boot.
EnrollTraineeModal.submit() posts the trainee first and the enrollment second with no compensating delete on failure — non-atomic write that pollutes the trainees collection.
MessagingSimulator chips are keyed on the message flag + global `phase`, so previously answered chip groups from earlier messages remain interactive; gate them per-message (e.g. m.answered).

Notes for scripts: risk-card and ML cards load async (poll up to 10s); toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s so poll [data-sonner-toast] every 500ms; generate a verification token with `python /app/backend/tests/qa_make_token.py`; clean QA data with `python /app/backend/tests/qa_cleanup.py`.
rca_of_the_issue: Enroll failure RCA: server.py assert_trainee_access -> accessible_trainee_ids builds a provider's allowed trainee list as trainee_ids_for_programs(program_ids_for_provider(provider_id)), i.e. only trainees who ALREADY have an enrollment in that provider's programs. POST /api/enrollments calls assert_trainee_access BEFORE the enrollment exists, so a freshly created trainee is always outside the provider's scope -> 403. Verified with qa_enroll_repro.py: create trainee 200, then enrollment with the provider's OWN program -> 403. ProviderDashboard crash RCA: load() catches the API error and toasts, but leaves summary=null while `loading` flips to false, and the JSX dereferences summary.placement_rate -> uncaught TypeError and a blank error overlay; reproduced by setting localStorage.skilltrace_token='bogus.token.value' and reloading /provider.
